import re
import sys

values = {}
assignment = re.compile(r"^\s*(\w+)\s*<-\s*(.*?)\s*;?\s*$")
expression = re.compile(r"\(\s*(\w+)\s*([+-])\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*(\d+)")

for line in sys.stdin:
    match = assignment.match(line)
    if not match:
        continue

    name, rhs = match.groups()
    expr_match = expression.fullmatch(rhs)
    if expr_match:
        var, operator, amount, modulus = expr_match.groups()
        amount = int(amount)
        result = values[var] + amount if operator == "+" else values[var] - amount
        values[name] = result % int(modulus)
    else:
        values[name] = int(rhs)

print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in
                ("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP")) + ";")
